entries.title: Illustrative migration assistant import flow with wordpress wxr available as an import source preview.
entries.notes: Illustrative deterministic catalogue fixture, not a live package UI capture. Install Migration Assistant first, then WordPress Importer. Capture the source selection state where the WXR reader is visible.
entries.useCase: An operator sees WordPress WXR as an available source in the Migration Assistant import flow.

entries.title: Parsed WordPress WXR rows previewed in Migration Assistant.
entries.notes: Use a small WXR fixture with at least one post and one page to show extracted title, slug, status, date, categories, tags, and author fields.
entries.useCase: An operator previews parsed WXR posts/pages with title, slug, status, date, categories, tags, and author fields.

entries.title: Import session detail for a WordPress WXR import.
entries.notes: Migration Assistant owns the page; include this screenshot when a demo import session can be created.
entries.useCase: An operator reviews the Migration Assistant import session created for a WordPress WXR import.

entries.title: Completed WordPress import report.
entries.notes: Capture a completed WXR import with created pages/posts, skipped rows, media references, and taxonomy mapping summary.
entries.useCase: An operator confirms what the WordPress import created before publishing migrated content.

entries.title: WordPress import validation errors.
entries.notes: Capture invalid WXR parsing or unsupported row warnings with fixture data, including safe row-level messages and recovery affordances.
entries.useCase: An operator fixes or skips problematic WordPress rows before running an import.

entries.title: WordPress import rollback state.
entries.notes: Capture rollback/recovery state when Migration Assistant can seed a WordPress import session with created content references.
entries.useCase: An operator understands how to recover from a WordPress import that should not be kept.
